# Esvin Creative

> Esvin Creative is a technology consulting and software engineering firm based in Hyderabad, India. We act as an end-to-end technology partner for organizations, taking full ownership of technical architecture, development, and long-term support.

## Core Services

- **Custom Software Development**: We engineer custom business platforms, internal operational tools, customer portals, and full-scale SaaS applications tailored to specific business needs. 
- **Mobile App Development**: We build high-performance native iOS, native Android, and cross-platform Flutter applications. We also manage App Store and Google Play publishing and compliance.
- **Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps**: We architect, migrate, and manage scalable cloud infrastructure on AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and Vercel. We automate CI/CD pipelines, containerize applications, and ensure rigorous security and disaster recovery.
- **Technology Consulting**: Strategic IT consulting designed to align technology investments with business goals through digital transformation, technology audits, architecture reviews, and vendor consolidation.

## Who We Serve
We serve a diverse range of clients globally and locally in India, including:
- Educational Institutions
- Startups & Scale-ups
- SMEs & Enterprise
- Non-Profits
- Professional Services

## Why Esvin Creative?
Esvin Creative bridges the gap between high-level business strategy and deep technical execution. Rather than just providing advisory reports, we have the in-house engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and maintain the solutions we recommend, eliminating the complexity of managing multiple vendors.
